findings.problem: Line 1 states "Paul stands up in that synagogue", which is Acts 13:16 (and 13:14 for the synagogue). The only reference on that line is (Acts 13:17-23), so this fact has no reference. Changing it to (Acts 13:16-23) would fix it.

rule.text: **References.** Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.

findings.problem: big-idea.md asks for "about 5 to 7 lines" and says each line is one entry. This output has 7 entries, but several are long paragraphs. Line 3 has four sentences and about 60 words, and the whole Big Idea is about 330 words. The docs don't say how long one line may be.
findings.question: Does a Big Idea "line" mean a single short sentence or line of text, or can one entry be a multi-sentence paragraph? Should there be a word or sentence limit for each entry or for the whole Big Idea?
